Class CachingConfigProvider<T>

java.lang.Object
me.bristermitten.mittenlib.config.provider.CachingConfigProvider<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The type of the config
All Implemented Interfaces:
Provider<T>, jakarta.inject.Provider<T>, javax.inject.Provider<T>, ConfigProvider<T>, SaveableConfigProvider<T>, WrappingConfigProvider<T>
public class CachingConfigProvider<T> extends Object implements ConfigProvider<T>, WrappingConfigProvider<T>, SaveableConfigProvider<T>
A ConfigProvider that caches the config to avoid repeated file reads.

    • path

      public Optional<Path> path()
      Description copied from interface: ConfigProvider
      The path of the source for the config, if available

      This is not always required - if the config came from a URL or String, for example, then this would be expected to return an Optional.empty()

      However, if it is coming from the file system (in most cases, it will), then a filled optional should be returned to allow things like FileWatchingConfigProvider to be implemented.

      Specified by:
      path in interface ConfigProvider<T>
      Returns:
      The path for of the config's source

    • clearCache

      public void clearCache()
      Description copied from interface: ConfigProvider
      Clear any and all cached config, if applicable. If this is a WrappingConfigProvider, then this method should also be called on the result of WrappingConfigProvider.getWrapped().

      This may be a no-op if the config is not cached.

      Specified by:
      clearCache in interface ConfigProvider<T>
